pages.title: Dark Energy
pages.text: The energy of empty space itself. It pushes galaxies apart, accelerating the expansion of the universe. Bottled, it fills its flask completely, and the flask seems slightly larger inside than out. It is the largest share of everything, and the least understood.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In 1998, distant supernovae showed the expansion of the universe is accelerating. The Dark Energy Siphon drew a sliver of that energy from the vacuum and held it.
